raw_segments.text: Father Conmey sat in a corner of the tram car, a blue ticket tucked with care in the eye of one plump kid glove,
while four shillings, a sixpence and five pennies, shooted from his other plump glove upon into his purse.
Passing the Ivy Church, he reflected that the ticket inspector usually made his visit when one had carelessly thrown away the ticket.
The solemnity of the occupants of the car seemed to Father Conmey excessive for a journey so short and cheap.
